body: Do the assertSession() methods work? https://book.cakephp.org/4/en/development/testing.html#testing-flash-messages has an example usage of assertSession().

> I might be missing something here, but I am not sure how assertSession() can be used to just check the existence of something not null in the session key.

You're right that `assertSession()` is not a good fit for this scenario. We could add an `assertSessionHasKey()` or `assertSessionNotNull()` method though to make that possible though.

I'll see if I can reproduce the `_requestSession` erasing the `$_SESSION` on use as that is not how it should be working in a test scenario.
